mtvr_mk23.name: RNG US-K23
mtvr_mk23.desc_ui_id: Built to go over even the roughest terrains and through the most hazardous environments, the RNG US-K23 is a high-performance, extremely durable, all-terrain vehicle military personnel can rely on. The RNG US-K23 easily carries 15 tons over the highway and up to 7.1 tons off-road. And with advanced technologies like independent suspension, the RNG US-K23 has the brawn to take on any obstacle that attempts to impede the mission.

mtvr_mk31.name: RNG M31 Military Tractor
mtvr_mk31.desc_ui_id: RNG M31 tractor has the maneuverability and versatility to haul equipment and supplies wherever they are needed, in any type of terrain – even the most extreme. Engineered to be rugged and durable, the RNG US-K31 tractor provides the power and performance to haul construction equipment, as well as move defense vehicles and refuelers. Combat-proven advanced technologies like the independent suspension system assure the highest degree of performance on every mission.

rng_lmv.name: RNG LMV
rng_lmv.desc_ui_id: The RNG Family of Light Multi Purpose Vehicle (LMV) have been trusted to move cargoes, recover vehicles. Higher capacity suspension, Improved ride quality, Improved mobility, Increased engine power, Higher capacity alternator, Modernized 24-volt electrical system

UnipogMP500.desc_ui_id: It may not be the biggest or the quickest... but the humble Unipog MP500 will get any job done.
